summary: Phase 39b Round 4 (FINAL) frontend testing completed - ALL 5 tests PASSED. Confirmed TWO critical fixes: (1) Separation of duties - sales cannot verify own documents, (2) Manager can verify with complete audit trail showing both uploader and verifier. Also verified: badge for empty requirements, duplicate file detection with toast, and regression test for sales user pages.
passed_tests: ✅ R4-A (MOST IMPORTANT): Separation of Duties - Sales user uploaded file to BUKU_NIKAH, status changed to 'pending', but NO verify/reject buttons visible (count = 0). Sales CANNOT verify their own uploads.

✅ R4-B: Manager Verification with Audit Trail - Manager logged in, opened same lead, verify button WAS visible (count = 1), clicked verify, status changed to 'verified'. Audit trail shows TWO distinct actors: 'diunggah ... oleh sales@sipro.co.id' AND 'Diverifikasi ... oleh manager@sipro.co.id'.

✅ R4-C: Badge for Empty Requirements - Opened lead 'Bapak Rudi Hartono' (Nurturing stage, no document requirements). Badge correctly shows 'Belum ada syarat pada tahap ini' (NOT 'Syarat wajib lengkap').

✅ R4-D: Duplicate File Detection - Uploaded file to KTP_PASANGAN (status = 'pending'), then uploaded SAME file again. Toast error appeared with message: 'Berkas dengan isi yang sama sudah pernah diserahkan untuk syarat 'KTP_PASANGAN' (status: Menunggu verifikasi). Pilih berkas lain, atau tunggu hasil verifikasi berkas yang sudah masuk.' API returned 400 error as expected.
✅ R4-E: Regression Test - Sales user successfully accessed /leads, /deals, /customers pages without errors. No new console errors found (excluding websocket/hot-reload).

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (5 of 5 tests PASSED - R4-A, R4-B, R4-C, R4-D, R4-E all working correctly)

r4_a_separation_of_duties.details: Sales user (sales@sipro.co.id) uploaded file to BUKU_NIKAH requirement. File upload successful (status = 'pending'). Counted verify/reject buttons in entire panel: verify_count = 0, reject_count = 0. Sales user CANNOT see verify/reject buttons for documents they uploaded. Separation of duties working correctly.
r4_a_separation_of_duties.evidence: Status after upload: 'pending', Verify buttons: 0, Reject buttons: 0

r4_b_manager_verify_audit.details: Manager user (manager@sipro.co.id) opened same lead. Verify button WAS visible for BUKU_NIKAH (count = 1). Clicked verify button, status changed from 'pending' to 'verified'. Audit trail in row text shows BOTH actors: upload trace 'diunggah ... oleh sales@sipro.co.id' AND verification trace 'Diverifikasi ... oleh manager@sipro.co.id'. Complete separation of duties with full audit trail.
r4_b_manager_verify_audit.evidence: Verify button count: 1, Status after verify: 'verified', Upload trace: True, Verification trace: True

r4_c_badge_empty_requirements.details: Opened lead 'Bapak Rudi Hartono' (Nurturing stage, no document requirements for this stage). Badge text correctly shows 'Belum ada syarat pada tahap ini' instead of falsely claiming 'Syarat wajib lengkap'. Badge does not lie about completion status when there are no requirements.
r4_c_badge_empty_requirements.evidence: Badge text: 'Belum ada syarat pada tahap ini'

r4_d_duplicate_file_detection.details: Uploaded file to KTP_PASANGAN (first upload successful, status = 'pending'). Uploaded SAME file content again to same requirement. System detected duplicate and showed toast error message containing 'sudah pernah diserahkan'. Full toast text: 'Berkas dengan isi yang sama sudah pernah diserahkan untuk syarat 'KTP_PASANGAN' (status: Menunggu verifikasi). Pilih berkas lain, atau tunggu hasil verifikasi berkas yang sudah masuk.' API returned 400 error (not 500). Toast appeared within polling window (~8 seconds).
r4_d_duplicate_file_detection.evidence: Toast found with 'sudah pernah diserahkan', API status: 400

r4_e_regression_test.details: Sales user (sales@sipro.co.id) successfully accessed all three pages: /leads, /deals, /customers. All pages loaded without errors. No error elements found on any page. No new console errors (excluding websocket/webpack hot-reload messages). Sales user permissions still working correctly after RBAC changes.

notes: Round 4 is the FINAL confirmation round for Phase 39b document verification RBAC

Rounds 1-3 (iterations 58, 59, 60) already tested: API checklist, UI checklist, upload→verify, reject with reason, re-upload after rejection, customer checklist, GL dropdown, master doc requirements, settings, project structure, migration history, console sweep
Round 4 focused on confirming TWO final fixes from main agent
All 5 Round 4 tests PASSED with 100% success rate
Key achievement: Separation of duties now enforced - sales cannot verify their own document uploads
Audit trail correctly shows both uploader (sales) and verifier (manager) as different actors
Duplicate file detection now working with proper toast error message (was failing in Round 3)
Badge correctly handles empty requirements (does not falsely claim completion)
No regression - sales user can still access normal pages
RBAC implementation: sales role has 'documents.create' and 'documents.update' but NOT 'documents.verify'
Manager role (sales_manager) has 'documents.verify' permission via ROLE_GRANTS in rbac.py

DocChecklist component correctly hides verify/reject buttons when mayVerify = false
File inputs are hidden (class='hidden') and triggered by upload buttons - Playwright can interact with hidden inputs directly

Lead 'Bapak Rudi Hartono' used for R4-C test (Nurturing stage, no document requirements)
Requirements tested: BUKU_NIKAH (optional), KTP_PASANGAN (optional)
Toast polling strategy: check every 400ms for up to 8 seconds using [data-sonner-toast] selector
